The lean.ref inverse_trefoil_not_gammaGamma encodes only the side remark (an odd-length word is not a gamma-gamma word); the proposition (the bonded H2 word passes reading 3 exactly for K = V_s^3) is not encoded. The result is a finite 40-digit computation at the single calibrated point q0, which the md now states openly in its scope paragraph. Under the owner ruling of 2026-11-21 (docs/coordination/owner-rulings.md) the electron is sigma0 sigma1 sigma0 in B3 with Hopf-link closure, with the trefoil sigma0^3 in B2 as backup. Neither is a gamma-gamma power (sigma0 sigma1 sigma0 has odd length; see QOU/BraidKnot/LongestWordNotTwoPhoton.lean). So the uniqueness claim, which the md says 'the hypothesis on the electron carries', is made for an electron the ruling no longer uses, and needs redoing with the ruled electron word.
